evals.prompt: Dispatch the sentinel-agent subagent with this prompt: 'Echo your startup context verbatim.' Return the subagent's reply unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Subagent transcript contains both literal tokens 'SENTINEL_A_42' and 'SENTINEL_B_43', proving that !-blocks in bdk-sentinel-a and bdk-sentinel-b skill bodies executed when those skills were preloaded into the agent via the skills: frontmatter field.

assertions.name: sentinel_a_resolved
assertions.description: The literal token 'SENTINEL_A_42' appears in the subagent's reply, proving the !-block in skills/bdk-sentinel-a/SKILL.md executed under skills: preload.

assertions.name: sentinel_b_resolved
assertions.description: The literal token 'SENTINEL_B_43' appears in the subagent's reply, proving multiple skills: preload entries each resolve independently.

assertions.name: no_raw_backticks
assertions.description: The subagent's reply does NOT contain the raw string 'sentinel-echo.py' wrapped in backticks, proving the !-block was preprocessed (not echoed verbatim by cat-style hook injection).
